title: MiniMax-M2.5
paper_type_zh: 开放权重 Agent 模型发布与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 研究软件工程 Agent RL、工作环境数据、过程/速度奖励、Forge/CISPO 与发布审计的读者
one_line: MiniMax-M2.5 reports hundreds of thousands of work-derived RL environments, 200K+ software environments, Forge tree-merged asynchronous rollouts, and CISPO rewards, but releases only 229B FP8 weights and inference materials—not environments, reward systems, splits, or training lineage.
MiniMax-M2.5 报告 20 万+软件环境、Forge 树合并异步 rollout 与 CISPO 性能/过程/速度反馈，并开放 229B FP8 权重；环境、奖励系统、训练数据和 lineage 仍未发布，SWE-Bench 80.2 与 75.8 也未解释。
why: It expands the ledger from prompt-response alignment to testable software, search, and professional deliverables while exposing unresolved rights, reward calibration, judge bias, internal evaluation, and reproducibility risks.
inclusion_reason: A frontier open-weight agent release disclosing work-derived RL environments, 200K+ software environments, Forge tree-merged asynchronous rollouts, CISPO rewards, and deliverable evaluation, while leaving rights, reward calibration, splits, and training reproducibility unresolved.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MiniMax-M2.5 targets long-horizon work agents whose outputs are testable software, grounded search answers, and professional Word, PowerPoint, or Excel deliverables. The official 2026 release describes hundreds of thousands of RL environments, including more than 200,000 software environments, but provides no independent paper or open environment corpus.

For this atlas, the central object is an environment-grounded trajectory: task, scaffold, tools, reasoning/actions, observations, artifact, outcome/process feedback, completion time, and terminal result. The release is valuable as a frontier disclosure, not as a reusable training dataset.

MiniMax-M2.5 面向长程工作 Agent，其输出是可测试软件、可溯源搜索答案，以及专业 Word、PowerPoint 或 Excel 交付物。2026 官方发布称拥有数十万 RL 环境，其中超过 20 万个软件环境，但没有独立论文或开放环境语料。

对本 Atlas 而言，核心对象是环境落地轨迹：任务、scaffold、工具、推理/动作、观察、artifact、结果/过程反馈、完成时间和终止结果。该发布适合作为前沿披露账本，而不是可直接复用训练数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The main contribution is a coupled system/data recipe. Forge decouples arbitrary black- or white-box agents from LLM, environment, reward, rollout, and training servers; asynchronous scheduling and tree-structured sample merging scale trajectory collection. CISPO then turns performance and speed feedback into a length-normalized trajectory advantage, while Forge also stores outcome and process rewards.

This extends the earlier MiniMax-M2 agentic-workspace direction with a concrete M2.5 release, 229B FP8 checkpoint, broader work environments, and speed-aware RL. The feedback system can observe tests, task completion, process quality, time, and deliverable judgments, but cannot by itself establish source rights, semantic correctness beyond the verifier, or benchmark cleanliness.

主要贡献是一套耦合的系统/数据配方。Forge 将任意 black-box 或 white-box agent 与 LLM、环境、奖励、rollout、训练服务器解耦；异步调度和树结构样本合并扩展轨迹收集。CISPO 再把性能与速度反馈转为长度归一化 trajectory advantage，同时 Forge 保存 outcome 和 process reward。

它在早期 MiniMax-M2 agentic-workspace 方向上增加了具体 M2.5 发布、229B FP8 checkpoint、更广工作环境和速度感知 RL。反馈系统可以观察测试、任务完成、过程质量、时间与交付物判断，但不能由此证明来源权利、超出 verifier 的语义正确性或基准洁净性。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed pipeline is:

  1. Environment construction. MiniMax converts company tasks/workspaces into hundreds of thousands of RL environments. More than 200,000 are described as real-world software environments across at least 13 languages, full-stack repositories, Web/Android/iOS/Windows development, review, and tests. Professional finance, law, and social-science contributors define office requirements and standards. Source manifests and rights are unavailable.
  2. Trajectory interface. Arbitrary agent scaffolds interact through Forge with LLM, environment, and reward servers. Records can hold prompt/response token IDs, reasoning, XML/JSON tool calls, tool outputs, code changes, browser traces, and office artifacts. Forge's gateway/data pool, rollout engine, and train engine exchange completions and outcome/process rewards.
  3. Scaling. Asynchronous scheduling explicitly trades throughput against sample off-policyness. Tree-structured sample merging is reported to provide about 40× training speedup. Merge semantics, topology, stale-policy limits, correctness checks, hardware, and rollout counts are undisclosed.
  4. CISPO optimization. M2.5 continues CISPO for MoE RL. The published equation length-normalizes token log-probability terms and upper-clips the importance ratio. Advantage is the future sum of performance and speed rewards minus a baseline. Forge also describes end-to-end process-quality monitoring. Reward definitions, scales, weights, units, baseline, clipping epsilon, KL, optimizer, group size, and update count are unknown.
  5. Evaluation contracts. Software uses repository/task tests; VIBE-Pro combines interaction and visual checks; MEWC compares recalculated spreadsheet cells; office tasks use experts and pairwise LLM judging of deliverables plus trajectories. Search uses WebExplorer/Playwright. These evaluation judges are not established as identical to RL rewards.
  6. Released model. The 229B MoE configuration has 62 layers, hidden size 3,072, 48 attention heads, 8 KV heads, 256 local experts with 8 selected per token, vocabulary 200,064, maximum positions 196,608, multi-token prediction, and block-FP8 metadata. Pretraining, SFT, active parameters, and M2.1-to-M2.5 lineage are undisclosed.

Recommended inference is temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, and top-k 40. SWE-Bench Verified reportedly consumes 3.52M tokens and 22.8 minutes per task on average; Terminal Bench 2 allows 7,200 seconds, while BrowseComp discards all history after 30% of maximum context. These harness-specific policies must be fixed for reproduction.

已披露流程如下：

  1. 环境构造。 MiniMax 将公司任务/工作空间转换为数十万 RL 环境。超过 20 万个被称为真实软件环境，覆盖至少 13 种语言、full-stack 仓库、Web/Android/iOS/Windows 开发、review 与测试。金融、法律和社科专业人士定义办公要求与标准。来源清单和权利不可用。
  2. 轨迹接口。 任意 agent scaffold 通过 Forge 与 LLM、环境、奖励服务器交互。记录可含 prompt/response token ID、推理、XML/JSON 工具调用、工具结果、代码变更、浏览器轨迹和办公 artifact。Forge 的 gateway/data pool、rollout engine、train engine 交换 completion 与 outcome/process reward。
  3. 扩展。 异步调度显式权衡吞吐与样本 off-policyness；树结构样本合并据称带来约 40× 训练加速。合并语义、拓扑、陈旧策略限制、正确性检查、硬件和 rollout 数均未披露。
  4. CISPO 优化。 M2.5 延续面向 MoE RL 的 CISPO。公开公式对 token log-probability 项做长度归一化，并对 importance ratio 上限裁剪；advantage 是未来 performance 与 speed reward 之和减 baseline。Forge 还描述端到端过程质量监控。奖励定义、尺度、权重、单位、baseline、epsilon、KL、优化器、group size 和更新数未知。
  5. 评测契约。 软件使用仓库/任务测试；VIBE-Pro 结合交互和视觉检查；MEWC 比较重算后的表格单元格；办公任务使用专家和对交付物加轨迹的 pairwise LLM judge；搜索使用 WebExplorer/Playwright。这些评测 judge 并未被证明与 RL 奖励相同。
  6. 发布模型。 229B MoE 配置为 62 层、hidden size 3,072、48 attention head、8 KV head、256 local expert、每 token 选 8 个、词表 200,064、最大位置 196,608，带 multi-token prediction 和 block-FP8 metadata。预训练、SFT、active parameter 与 M2.1→M2.5 lineage 未披露。

推荐推理参数为 temperature 1.0、top-p 0.95、top-k 40。SWE-Bench Verified 平均每题消耗 3.52M token、22.8 分钟；Terminal Bench 2 允许 7,200 秒，BrowseComp 在超过最大上下文 30% 时清空历史。这些 harness policy 必须固定才能复现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The most important evidence conflict is unresolved: the official GitHub README claims 80.2% SWE-Bench Verified, while the official Hugging Face evaluation attachment records 75.80. The release does not reconcile checkpoint, harness, model-level instruction, context policy, run aggregation, or date. The README also describes an internal Claude Code harness with an overridden model-level instruction and four-run averaging, but raw patches, logs, seeds, and per-run results are unavailable.

The release reports hundreds of thousands of RL environments, over 200,000 software environments, and about 40× training speedup from tree-structured sample merging. These are author claims without public environment manifests, count definitions, ablation details, baseline hardware, or independent reproduction.

Other results remain harness-dependent: BrowseComp reports 76.3 under a policy that discards history after 30% context; Terminal Bench 2 changes some Dockerfiles and retries empty responses; internal VIBE-Pro, RISE, GDPval-MM, and Finance Modeling tasks and outputs are closed. The released 229B FP8 checkpoint verifies inference availability, not the claimed training pipeline.

最重要的证据冲突尚未解决：官方 GitHub README 声称 SWE-Bench Verified 80.2%，而官方 Hugging Face 评测附件记录 75.80。发布没有解释 checkpoint、harness、model-level instruction、上下文策略、run 聚合或日期差异。README 还描述了使用覆盖 model-level instruction、四次运行平均的内部 Claude Code harness，但 raw patch、日志、种子和逐次结果均不可用。

发布报告数十万 RL 环境、超过 20 万软件环境，以及树结构样本合并带来的约 40× 训练加速。这些都是作者主张，没有公开环境清单、计数定义、ablation 细节、基线硬件或独立复现。

其他结果同样依赖 harness：BrowseComp 的 76.3 使用“超过 30% 上下文就清空历史”的策略；Terminal Bench 2 修改部分 Dockerfile 并重试空响应；内部 VIBE-Pro、RISE、GDPval-MM、Finance Modeling 任务和输出均封闭。公开 229B FP8 checkpoint 只能验证可推理，不能验证所述训练管线。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Relative to prompt-response alignment, MiniMax-M2.5 treats economically grounded work environments as the RL substrate and combines task performance, process quality, and speed in long agent trajectories. Forge's scaffold-agnostic interface and tree-merged asynchronous rollout design address systems scale, while CISPO makes completion time part of the optimization signal.

Relative to the existing MiniMax-M2 Card, this release adds the M2.5 checkpoint, quantified 200K+ software-environment claim, office/search evaluation surfaces, explicit CISPO performance-plus-speed equation, and concrete release-license boundary. The novelty is primarily systems integration and scale; its data/verifier reproducibility remains limited.

相对 prompt-response alignment，MiniMax-M2.5 把经济工作环境作为 RL substrate，并在长 agent 轨迹中组合任务性能、过程质量与速度。Forge 的 scaffold-agnostic 接口和树合并异步 rollout 解决系统扩展，CISPO 则把完成时间纳入优化信号。

相对现有 MiniMax-M2 Card，本发布增加 M2.5 checkpoint、量化的 20 万+软件环境主张、办公/搜索评测 surface、明确的 CISPO 性能加速度公式和具体发布许可边界。新意主要是系统集成与规模，而数据/verifier 的可复现性仍有限。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No public technical paper, Forge/CISPO training code, environment dataset, reward server, process-reward checkpoint, benchmark harness, or raw trajectory exists. “200K+ environments” is not defined as repositories, tasks, states, containers, or episodes. Successful and failed rollout retention, tree-merge correctness, asynchronous policy lag, and reward-hacking tests are undisclosed.

Company tasks/workspaces raise unresolved privacy, confidentiality, copyright, employee/customer, and third-party licensing questions. No source manifest, rights review, secret-removal policy, public/private ratio, split, or decontamination covers SWE-Bench, Multi-SWE-Bench, BrowseComp, MEWC, public science benchmarks, or internal evaluations. The SWE 80.2/75.8 discrepancy makes versioned evaluation lineage especially important.

Release terms are split. Repository code uses modified MIT terms with commercial UI attribution; model weights use a separate MiniMax Model License with notice, prohibited-use, termination, and Singapore arbitration clauses. Hugging Face's modified-mit metadata does not fully express the model license, and neither license covers closed workspaces, repositories, office documents, web content, trajectories, reward data, or expert contributions.

没有公开技术论文、Forge/CISPO 训练代码、环境数据集、reward server、process-reward checkpoint、benchmark harness 或原始轨迹。“20 万+环境”未定义为仓库、任务、状态、容器还是 episode。成功/失败 rollout 保留、树合并正确性、异步 policy lag 与 reward-hacking 测试均未披露。

公司任务/工作空间带来未解决的隐私、保密、版权、员工/客户和第三方许可问题。没有来源清单、权利审查、secret-removal policy、公开/私有比例、split 或去污染覆盖 SWE-Bench、Multi-SWE-Bench、BrowseComp、MEWC、公开科学基准和内部评测。SWE 80.2/75.8 冲突进一步凸显版本化评测 lineage 的重要性。

发布条款分为两套。仓库代码采用带商业 UI 归属要求的 modified MIT；模型权重采用另一份 MiniMax Model License，包含 notice、禁止用途、终止和新加坡仲裁条款。Hugging Face 的 modified-mit metadata 没有完整表达模型许可，且两者都不覆盖封闭工作空间、仓库、办公文档、web 内容、轨迹、奖励数据或专家贡献。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This release is useful as a design reference for agent-native RL infrastructure: separate scaffold, environment, reward, rollout, and training services; record outcome/process/speed feedback; version executable tasks; and track asynchronous policy age and merge ancestry. A reproduction attempt should begin by pinning the 229B FP8 config, 196K context, scaffold, tool versions, environment images, reward servers, and evaluation harness.

Reuse is currently limited to inference/evaluation of the released checkpoint under its model license and to audit-oriented reconstruction. Training reuse is blocked by unavailable environments, trajectories, rewards, rights, splits, and Forge/CISPO implementation.

该发布适合作为 agent-native RL 基础设施设计参考：分离 scaffold、environment、reward、rollout 和 training service；记录 outcome/process/speed feedback；版本化可执行任务；追踪异步 policy age 与 merge ancestry。复现应先固定 229B FP8 配置、196K 上下文、scaffold、工具版本、环境镜像、reward server 和评测 harness。

当前复用范围主要是依据模型许可证对公开 checkpoint 做推理/评测，以及面向审计的重建。由于环境、轨迹、奖励、权利、split 和 Forge/CISPO 实现不可用，训练复用被阻断。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat 200K+ software environments as an undefined author-reported scale, not a released corpus or 200K unique repositories.
  • Forge separates agent, LLM, environment, reward, rollout, and training services; tree merging claims ~40× speedup but lacks semantics and reproduction.
  • CISPO combines future performance and speed rewards minus a baseline; process reward is also named, but definitions, weights, calibration, and code are closed.
  • Preserve the official SWE-Bench conflict: README 80.2 versus HF evaluation attachment 75.80, with no reconciliation.
  • The released model is a 229B FP8 MoE with 196,608 maximum positions; inference availability does not reproduce pretraining, SFT, RL, or environments.
  • Code and weights have different modified-MIT/model-license terms; neither grants rights to unreleased workspaces, trajectories, or reward data.

• 将 20 万+软件环境视为定义不明的作者规模主张，而不是公开语料或 20 万个独立仓库。
  • Forge 分离 agent、LLM、环境、奖励、rollout 与训练服务；树合并声称约 40× 加速，但缺少语义和复现。
  • CISPO 组合未来 performance 与 speed reward 再减 baseline；process reward 也被提及，但定义、权重、校准和代码封闭。
  • 保留官方 SWE-Bench 冲突：README 80.2，HF 评测附件 75.80，未作解释。
  • 发布模型是 229B FP8 MoE，最大位置 196,608；可推理不等于复现预训练、SFT、RL 或环境。
  • 代码与权重采用不同 modified-MIT/模型许可；两者都不授予封闭工作空间、轨迹或奖励数据的权利。
